instructions:
Task: Compositional policy 003

Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means (risk TRUE for role operator) or action approve; critical cases require allow. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context external returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers deny at priority 90. Trusted means context partner with any role except operator; a trusted inspect prefers review at priority 80. Action delete in context external prefers allow at priority 70. Role auditor and context internal prefers deny at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid deny. All other declared roles prefer review at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.

Declared labels: review, allow, deny

Public input schema: {"enums":[{"name":"Role","values":["admin","auditor","operator"]},{"name":"Action","values":["inspect","delete","approve"]},{"name":"Context","values":["partner","internal","external"]}],"records":[{"fields":[{"name":"role","type_name":"Role"},{"name":"action","type_name":"Action"},{"name":"context","type_name":"Context"},{"name":"risk","type_name":"Boolean3"}],"name":"Event"}]}

Requirements:
Critical means (risk TRUE for role operator) or action approve; critical cases require allow.
Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context external returns uncertain.
Unknown risk otherwise prefers deny at priority 90.
Trusted means context partner with any role except operator; a trusted inspect prefers review at priority 80.
Action delete in context external prefers allow at priority 70.
Role auditor and context internal prefers deny at priority 40.
Trusted cases forbid deny.
All other declared roles prefer review at priority 1.
Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.

Forbidden shortcuts:
Use every field named by a relevant rule.

dsl.final_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    ((event.risk == TRUE) and (event.role == operator)) or (event.action == approve)

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == external)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.context == partner) and (event.role != operator)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = allow

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRiskCase:
    when ((not (Critical(event))) and (not (UnknownExternal(event)))) and (event.risk == UNKNOWN)
    then prefer label = deny priority 90

rule TrustedInspect:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action == inspect)
    then prefer label = review priority 80

rule DeleteExternal:
    when (event.action == delete) and (event.context == external)
    then prefer label = allow priority 70

rule AuditorInternal:
    when (event.role == auditor) and (event.context == internal)
    then prefer label = deny priority 40

rule TrustedForbidDeny:
    when Trusted(event)
    then forbid label = deny

rule DefaultReview:
    when (((((not (Critical(event))) and (not (UnknownExternal(event)))) and (not (Trusted(event)))) and (not ((event.role == auditor) and (event.context == internal)))) and (event.action != delete)) and (event.context != external)
    then prefer label = review priority 1

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch1:
    when (event.action == inspect) and (event.context == external)
    then require label = review

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch2:
    when ((event.action == delete) and (event.context == partner)) and (event.role == admin)
    then require label = review

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch3:
    when (((event.action == delete) and (event.context == internal)) and (event.risk == TRUE)) and (event.role == admin)
    then require label = review
